project.description:
This package is a technical component, each sub-package representing a component. Each component includes two parts: 1. core package: the core encapsulation of the component 2. config package: the configuration of the component based on Spring
Technical components are also divided into two categories: 1. Framework components: extensions of the familiar jpa, Redis, etc. 2. Business components: encapsulation of components related to the business, such as data dictionaries, operation logs, etc. If it is a business component, the Maven name will contain biz
